title: a batch belongs to its step: its items live until the next batch, the source until the end of the scope
purpose: Observe failure, cleanup and lifetime ordering during execution.

stdout.text:
stream:          +stream b0(stream) +x +y got x got y -y -x b1(stream) +z got z -z b2(stream) after -stream
stream last:     +stream b0(stream) +x +y got x -y -x after -stream

provenance.origin: authored for #483/#484 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: #483/#484/#465: the scope owns the Batching source; each batch is owned while it is walked and its items are destroyed, in reverse order, before the next batch is asked for; last closes the batch first.
